_comment: SAMPLE Cloudflare WAF / firewall configuration for CarUp Vehicle Life Intelligence. This is a non-secret, declarative reference applied via Terraform or the Cloudflare API. Replace ${ZONE_ID} and contains NO secret values. See docs/vehicle-life-intelligence/WAF_DDOS_CONFIG.md.

request_limits._comment_upload: Evidence images/PDFs go through signed-URL upload; cap multipart body to limit abuse.
request_limits._comment_api_body: JSON API bodies are small; oversized bodies on /api/* are suspicious.

rate_based_rules.name: global-baseline
rate_based_rules.description: Coarse per-IP ceiling across the whole site.

rate_based_rules.name: api-rate
rate_based_rules.description: Tighter ceiling on the API surface.

rate_based_rules.name: auth-credential-stuffing
rate_based_rules.description: Aggressive limit on login/register/reset to defeat credential stuffing and brute force.

rate_based_rules.name: ocr-evidence-ingest
rate_based_rules.description: Throttle expensive evidence/OCR ingestion endpoints to protect AI cost budget.

custom_rules.name: protect-admin-routes
custom_rules.description: Admin and governance surfaces: allow only known operator IPs, challenge everyone else.

custom_rules.name: block-known-bad-methods
custom_rules.description: Reject methods the API never uses.

custom_rules.name: block-dotfile-and-env-probes
custom_rules.description: Block scanners probing for secrets / config files.

custom_rules.name: challenge-missing-ua-on-api
custom_rules.description: API traffic with no/empty User-Agent is almost always automated.

operator_allowlist.description: Operator/office egress IPs permitted to reach admin routes. Populate out of band; do NOT commit real IPs to source control.

logging._comment: Stream firewall_events to the observability sink; alert on spikes per OBSERVABILITY_AND_ALERTS.md (rate-limit/WAF events).
